sub6011: The story begins when your alarm wakes you up from a dream where you were dreaming of the golden retriever from your childhood

you have a stuffed animal that he had given to you in the relationship and you don't know how it ended there
you also see the piano which makes you remember more about your ex relationship
you proceed to see Tinder and you find your ex in the app
as a result of that you talk to your best friend Lex about how that made you feel
and she comes for you and you proceed to stalk your ex and go to his house only to see if he is with someone else
but the other girl turn out is his cousin and everything results in an awkward situation
Adam invites you to go for a coffee and you also remember with nostalgia the place where they used to go
but little by little you stop remembering it sadly for what it was and little by little you finish your mourning.
By the end you realize you've spent so much time idolizing the good part of the last relationship that you blocked out his flaws.
I interpret the story as the process of letting go of what once was and making way for new experiences and relationships embracing the process and learning from it.
